remarks: -Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom ranch home located on a wonderful street in the Town of Lancaster! This well-maintained home offers a comfortable layout and numerous updates. The eat-in kitchen features ceramic tile floor, all appliances and a ceiling fan, while the nicely sized front living room offers wall-to-wall carpeting. Down the hallway, you’ll find a full bathroom and three comfortable bedrooms. The full basement provides plenty of additional space for storage, hobbies, or future use. Major updates include a new furnace in 2018, central air conditioning installed in 2011, new siding in 2008, and a new 200-amp electrical service in 2023. The roof was replaced in 2008 with a complete tear-off. Step outside to enjoy the wonderful fully fenced backyard, complete with a covered stamped-concrete patio and attractive landscaping—perfect for relaxing, entertaining, and enjoying summer days and evenings. The attached 1.5-car garage includes a NEMA 14-50 outlet for convenient electric vehicle charging. This home shows beautifully and is in excellent condition. Conveniently located just minutes from the Village of Lancaster, with easy access to local events, shopping, restaurants, and more. A wonderful opportunity to own a move-in-ready ranch in a great location!
